polaris: Attack whether an independent input-side C_phi exists, or whether every measurable C_phi collapses to c-axis coherence, disorder, oxygen stoichiometry, dephasing, dz2/self-doping, strain, pressure history, and sample quality.
framework: Causal identifiability plus information-theoretic sufficient statistics, borrowed from econometrics: a proposed latent variable is non-independent if every admissible measurement is measurable with respect to the sigma-algebra generated by already-known confounders and baselines.
findings: Strong collapse case. Under realistic nickelate experiments, any input-side C_phi must be constructed from normal-state linear-response, spectroscopic, or structural observables. Those observables are generated by a small baseline set: effective c-axis hopping/coherence, scattering/dephasing, oxygen and topotactic-defect fields, strain/interface/capping state, pressure phase context, and dz2/rare-earth/self-doping spectral weight. Therefore C_phi is either a monotone reparameterization of c-axis coherence/sample quality, or a multivariate quality score over those baselines. A genuinely independent C_phi would require a pre-output residual invariant after conditioning on all these baselines; the B position is that realistic nickelate sample counts, hidden oxygen inhomogeneity, pressure hysteresis, and measurement covariance make such a residual non-identifiable and probably nonexistent.

math_object.name: Baseline sigma-algebra and conditional mutual information no-go
math_object.definition: Let B = (W_D,c, gamma_c, rho_c/rho_ab, W_dz2, n_RE/self_doping, V_O(r), epsilon_strain, interface/capping, P_history, disorder length). Let X be any pre-output observable allowed for C_phi: optical conductivity, normal-state transport anisotropy, ARPES/XAS/RIXS spectral weight, NMR linewidth/relaxation, structural microscopy, or SVD score built from these. Collapse means C_phi is B-measurable: C_phi = f(X) with X = g(B, eta), so I(C_phi; Z | B) = 0 for any later readiness target Z before superconducting output is opened.
math_object.operational_no_go: If all observables entering C_phi are normal-state one- or two-particle probes, then Kubo/Golden-rule forms reduce their c-axis sensitivity to effective interlayer matrix elements, spectral weights, and lifetimes: sigma_c(omega -> 0) ~ e^2 sum_k t_perp(k)^2 A(k,0)^2 tau_k; normal-state phase-memory proxies have the same numerator t_perp^2 times a dephasing denominator. Without using superconducting output or pair response, there is no independent phase-bus object left after t_perp, A, tau, dz2/self-doping, and disorder are fixed.

strangest_prediction: The most discriminating B prediction is rank non-invertibility: in matched nickelate films or pressure samples, no two samples will show a stable reversal where C_phi ranks sample i above sample j while the full baseline vector B ranks i below j, once oxygen disorder, c-axis Drude weight/scattering, dz2/rare-earth spectral weight, strain/interface, and pressure history are measured. Apparent reversals should vanish after adding one missing sample-quality variable, usually residual/apical oxygen, capping/interface state, dephasing, or dz2/self-doping.
a_objection: A will object that C_phi is not a scalar coherence strength but a bottleneck/observability variable, e.g. a multi-probe SVD score capturing recoverable phase-bus readiness. B response: an SVD score cannot create an independent physical variable if its columns are all baseline-generated observables. It only estimates the dominant latent quality axis unless it produces a conditional residual invariant under baseline-matched interventions.
failed_jumps: Music theory counterpoint: mapping independent voices to layers was only metaphorical; it did not yield an invariant distinguishable from interlayer coupling.
Neuroscience attractor memory: phase readiness as attractor basin depth collapses to dephasing time and connectivity strength when translated to nickelate probes.
Topology/protection: no identified topological index protects C_phi against disorder or oxygen fields in known nickelate normal-state measurements.

collapse_argument.step_1_measurement_closure: Every lab-feasible pre-output C_phi is built from observables already used to diagnose interlayer coherence or sample quality: c-axis optical Drude fraction, transport anisotropy, normal-state scattering rates, ARPES/XAS/RIXS orbital weights, NMR line broadening, structural oxygen maps, and pressure/strain metadata.
collapse_argument.step_2_common_cause: In nickelates these probes share common causes: topotactic reduction quality, residual/apical oxygen, oxygen vacancies, interface/capping chemistry, epitaxial strain, pressure path, rare-earth/dz2 self-doping, and disorder. These causes alter both the numerator of coherent c-axis motion and the denominator of dephasing.
collapse_argument.step_3_identifiability: Because realistic datasets have small N, partial structural characterization, pressure uncertainty, and correlated synthesis variables, C_phi cannot be identified as a separate latent factor unless there is a baseline-matched intervention. Observational residuals are not evidence for independence; they are more parsimoniously missing confounders.
collapse_argument.step_4_no_free_phase_variable: A phase-bus variable that is measured before superconducting output cannot directly observe condensate phase rigidity. It can only observe normal-state coherence channels. Thus its phase language is an interpretation of c-axis tunneling plus lifetime, not an independent input.

conditional_falsifier_for_B.criterion: B is falsified only by a pre-output sample pair or intervention where all components of B are matched within error but C_phi changes reproducibly and predicts a non-output readiness rank.
required_controls: Matched W_D,c and low-frequency sigma_c spectral weight.
Matched gamma_c or dephasing rate from optics/transport/NMR.
Matched oxygen vacancy and residual/apical oxygen maps, preferably depth-resolved.
Matched dz2/rare-earth/self-doping spectral weight from ARPES/XAS/RIXS or equivalent.
Matched strain, thickness, interface/capping layer, and pressure history.
No use of Tc, zero resistance, Meissner response, critical current, gap opening, or any bulk superconducting output.
conditional_falsifier_for_B.B_prediction: No robust residual remains: Delta C_phi | Delta B = 0 is bounded by measurement noise and batch effects.

next_plan: Round 2 B should try to formalize a minimal theorem: any scalar C_phi built from normal-state linear-response observables is either a function of the baseline vector B or is unidentifiable under nickelate sampling constraints. The theorem should separate mathematical collapse from empirical underpowering.
